svg.text: PyTorch-first Model Hub - Config + Model + Preprocessor - huggingface.co/docs/transformers
L1 - Applications + Model Families (NLP / vision / audio / multimodal - train and serve)
L2 - Hub Integration + AutoClasses (unified load/save - architecture auto-detect)
model_type in config.json selects architecture class
Same API across 500+ Hub model families
L3 - Model Layer (PreTrainedModel - PretrainedConfig - modular modeling files)
PeftAdapterMixin for LoRA/IA3 adapters at model level
Faithful to paper - One Model One File philosophy
L4 - Preprocessing Layer (raw input to model tensor format)
Combines tokenizer + image/audio in one API
DataCollator - pad to max length in batch
Vocab + merges stored in Hub checkpoint
L5 - Pipeline Inference API (task-specific end-to-end - no training loop)
Mix Hub model with custom tokenizer if needed
Pipeline = convenience wrapper for quick inference
L6 - Text Generation Stack (GenerationMixin - generate() - decoding algorithms)
Opt-in mixin on generative model classes
AutoModel adds mixin for Hub backward compat
Used by UIs and chat interfaces
L7 - Training + Quantization (Trainer API - HfQuantizer - distributed via Accelerate)
Model Load + Inference Flow (from Hub to output)
Three-class pattern: Config + Preprocessor + Model - unified from_pretrained()
Step 1: AutoTokenizer/Processor.from_pretrained - load vocab + chat template
Step 4: Decode output_ids - tokenizer.decode - stream via TextIteratorStreamer
Quick path: pipeline("text-generation", model=hub_id) bundles steps 1-4 automatically
Production: vLLM/SGLang reimplement loop - consume same Hub weights + tokenizer
PyTorch-first - faithful to papers - easy to use and hack - backwards compatible Hub
models/ - generation/ - pipelines/ - trainers/ - tokenization/ - quantizers/ - integrations/
TensorFlow/Flax legacy - PyTorch is primary path for new development
Design Position (de facto standard for pretrained model loading - research to production bridge)
Config + Model + Preprocessor - AutoClasses - pipeline for quick inference - Trainer for fine-tune
Sources: huggingface.co/docs/transformers - Philosophy - Auto Classes - Pipeline - Generation - Quantization docs
